notes: τε and καί each take one of the two written conjunctions (rule 70), consistent with ROM.1.14 and distinct from the single-conjunction cases at 1.20 and 1.26.
The reciprocal is discontinuous around the preposition and heads on 'another' (rules 15, 83).
τήν before 'unseemliness' is unrepresented for want of a determiner (rule 23), while τήν before 'recompense' takes the supplied demonstrative (rule 60).
